qualification_harness.cmake_source:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(FilesPaneSanitizers LANGUAGES CXX)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${SOURCE}" SOURCE)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${FIXTURES}" FIXTURES)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY MultiThreaded)
find_package(ckvision 1.4.0 CONFIG REQUIRED)
include("${SOURCE}/cmake/CkToolsStrict.cmake")
if(MSVC)
 add_compile_options(/fsanitize=address)
 add_link_options(/DEBUG /INCREMENTAL:NO)
else()
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
set(BUILD_TESTING ON)
enable_testing()
add_subdirectory("${SOURCE}/src/native-core/files" core)
add_library(ck_vision_shell STATIC "${SOURCE}/src/vision/suite_shell.cpp")
target_include_directories(ck_vision_shell PUBLIC "${SOURCE}/include")
target_link_libraries(ck_vision_shell PUBLIC ckvision::cvision)
cktools_strict(ck_vision_shell)
add_library(ck_vision_cktest_main STATIC "${SOURCE}/src/vision/host/cktest_main.cpp")
target_include_directories(ck_vision_cktest_main PUBLIC "${SOURCE}/tests/support")
target_link_libraries(ck_vision_cktest_main PUBLIC ckvision::cvision)
target_compile_definitions(ck_vision_cktest_main PUBLIC CKTOOLS_TEST_TEMP_ROOT="${FIXTURES}")
cktools_strict(ck_vision_cktest_main)
add_library(ck_options STATIC "${SOURCE}/src/common/options/options.cpp")
target_include_directories(ck_options PUBLIC "${SOURCE}/include" PRIVATE "${SOURCE}/src/tools/json-view/include")
target_compile_features(ck_options PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
add_library(ck_vision_keymap STATIC "${SOURCE}/src/vision/keymap/keymap.cpp" "${SOURCE}/src/vision/keymap/suite_keymap_catalog.cpp")
target_include_directories(ck_vision_keymap PUBLIC "${SOURCE}/include" PRIVATE "${SOURCE}/src/tools/json-view/include")
target_compile_features(ck_vision_keymap PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(ck_vision_keymap PUBLIC ckvision::cvision ck_options)
add_subdirectory("${SOURCE}/src/vision/files" ui)

add_executable(ck_files_directory_row_tests "${SOURCE}/tests/unit/ck_files/test_files_indexed_pane.cpp" "${SOURCE}/tests/unit/ck_files/test_files_index_file_native.cpp")
target_link_libraries(ck_files_directory_row_tests PRIVATE ck_files_platform ck_vision_cktest_main)
target_compile_definitions(ck_files_directory_row_tests PRIVATE CKTOOLS_FILES_PRIVATE_INDEX_TEST_ROOT="${CKTOOLS_FILES_PRIVATE_INDEX_TEST_ROOT}")
cktools_strict(ck_files_directory_row_tests)
add_test(NAME directory_row_core COMMAND ck_files_directory_row_tests --suite test_files_indexed_pane.cpp)
add_test(NAME directory_row_native COMMAND ck_files_directory_row_tests --suite test_files_index_file_native.cpp)
set_tests_properties(directory_row_core directory_row_native PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 180)

thread_sanitizer_harness:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(FilesPaneThreadSanitizer LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
include("${SOURCE}/cmake/CkToolsStrict.cmake")
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_compile_options(-fsanitize=thread -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
add_link_options(-fsanitize=thread -fno-sanitize-recover=all)
add_subdirectory("${SOURCE}/src/native-core/files" core)
add_executable(pane_service_tsan "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/files_pane_service.cpp" "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files/tests/files_pane_service_tests.cpp" "${SOURCE}/src/vision/host/cktest_main.cpp")
target_include_directories(pane_service_tsan PRIVATE "${SOURCE}/src/vision/files" "${SOURCE}/tests/support" "${SDK}/include")
target_compile_definitions(pane_service_tsan PRIVATE CKTOOLS_TEST_TEMP_ROOT="${FIXTURES}" CKTOOLS_FILES_PRIVATE_INDEX_TEST_ROOT="${PRIVATE_FIXTURES}")
target_link_libraries(pane_service_tsan PRIVATE ck_files_platform Threads::Threads)
cktools_strict(pane_service_tsan)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME pane_service_tsan COMMAND pane_service_tsan)
set_tests_properties(pane_service_tsan PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)

windows_stress_harness.scope: Wall-clock harness guard only; all 100000-row data, wire/storage/advance bounds and test assertions remain unchanged.

retirement.reason: Native stress external sort exceeded 180-second harness deadline; no sanitizer finding, suite did not complete.

excluded_windows_timeout.explanation: Unchanged native 100000-row external sort exceeded original 180-second harness guard with no sanitizer finding. Exact process exit, empty orphan and owned diagnostic retirement were checked. The full harness was rebuilt/repeated with a 600-second native-suite guard, preserving all correctness checks. A first retry invocation was rejected by the workspace-exists guard before any build while the empty orphan still required review. All pre-origin-fix service runs are excluded from final qualification.

timing_investigation.normal: Final Mac incremental build 4.601 s versus recent 4.885 s for the same two-C++-action/archive/executable scope. Exact normal compile-action logs, changed source/object/executable hashes and timestamp ordering are retained. Matching remote manifests and final full instrumented rebuilds cover all changed inputs; elapsed time alone does not prove freshness.
timing_investigation.sdk: Final clean instrumented SDK builds compile all 124/124/128 C++ units. Mac 53.429 s versus prior same-SDK 84.632 s and an earlier overloaded 366.223 s; Linux 78.126 s versus 156.291 s and earlier 175.591 s. Windows configure/build/install together 84.044 s versus prior 76.029 s. All actual compile actions, source/install/archive hashes, flags and absence of compiler-cache launchers are verified. Earlier load above 100 and roughly 21 GB swap usage was recorded; scheduling/resource contention is a plausible contributor, not a proven sole cause.
timing_investigation.product: Final clean 73-unit harness builds take 50.305/102.255/75.215 s on Mac/Linux/Windows, compared with prior same-size 84.064/148.481/67.861 s and earlier overloaded 145.847/379.220 s on Mac/Linux. TSan was scheduled before final ASan SDK/product builds to avoid additional simultaneous owned compiler load on the Mac/Lima host. All 73 actual product compile actions, final source hashes, sanitizer flags and both linked output identities are verified.
timing_investigation.tests: Final matched sanitizer tests execute every platform-specific case. The Windows native 100000-row suite completes in 213.29 s, versus prior 139.16 s; an earlier 180-second guard expired in external sort. Native data, storage/wire/advance bounds and assertions are unchanged. The Windows-only 600-second wall-clock guard permits complete instrumented validation; no native case was skipped. Failed-tree cleanup and final complete test logs are preserved. New service safety cases are deterministic, not duration assertions.
timing_investigation.thread: UI-free TSan compiles all 62 expected units and runs every service case three times. Final build durations 51.052/45.618 s on Mac/Linux versus earlier overloaded 146.600/132.643 s. Exact action counts, source hashes, flags, test names and cleanup are checked; resource observations and stage ordering explain the investigation, without using speed as proof.

thread_test_header.scope: Public header-only test runner; UI SDK libraries are not linked into the UI-free TSan harness.

review.navigation: Exclusive child navigation carries exact originating navigation ticket, current stamp and explicit scoped row. The worker checks epoch/stamp, binds the held-parent relative directory and retains that cursor through complete listing/index/first-page preparation. No mark/cursor retargeting, absolute child-path reopen or fallback. Complete renderable candidate commits only under latest-ticket/cancellation guard.
review.routes: Owner-free requested routes retain an exact native absolute root and exact native descendant components. There is no flat-host-path conversion. Windows literal/reserved-looking/trailing-space/dot/unpaired-surrogate values and raw POSIX bytes are preserved. Display joining is presentation only, never target reconstruction or a current-pathname-membership promise. Byte/depth/encoding bounds refuse explicitly.
review.retirement: Old/staged pane retirement finishes on the worker outside the commit mutex BEFORE acknowledgment. This revokes old display stamps before replacement delivery and prevents a consumed reply while native retirement is blocked. New gated regression proves that boundary. Native owners never enter replies or UI dispatch. Origin readiness is checked before lazy backend startup; a failed initial navigation cannot trigger additional native workspace/source queries from an unresolved child request.
review.failure: Failed/cancelled/stale/oversized/unrenderable children retain previous pane, marks and active route. A refused navigation advances the acknowledged epoch for the retained pane; old tickets cannot be reused. Absolute navigation supersedes blocked child work. Native errors win over concurrent cancellation; explicit helper interruption is cancellation. Requested child route is absent until scoped binding; first-page failure may retain requested candidate route separately from active route. Terminal faults publish owner-free unknown acknowledgment, without retry.
review.tests: Twelve new location/service cases plus extended real-native child traversal. All 83 Files suites pass 832/835/831 cases on macOS/Linux/Windows, plus keymap. Matched ASan+UBSan Mac/Linux and ASan Windows runs pass 142/140/139 cases: 72 UI/service, 53 indexed-pane and 17/15/14 native-index. All 73 product units and installed instrumented pinned ckVision 1.4.0 SDK 124/124/128 units verified. UI-free TSan executes all 40 service cases three times per Mac/Linux host (120 executions each), with no findings.
review.excluded: Pre-retirement-fix normal runs are excluded. Windows exposed a stale-stamp publication race because old pane destruction could follow new reply consumption. The production fix retires the old/staged pane before publication; the deterministic gated regression does not weaken the expectation. A final review additionally moved origin validation ahead of lazy backend startup and added its zero-extra-query regression. All pre-origin-fix service qualification is excluded; final qualification uses the corrected source and 40-case suite.
review.scope: WP-02 remains open for application child-entry command, navigation input/completion, qualified refresh, properties/preview, histories/bookmarks, production executable and actual terminal acceptance. Existing controller labels consume structured routes; no GUI was launched. No source filesystem mutation enabled.
